reason: I already pay a marketing person to plan our posts, so an AI sending me three captions a week doesn't take anything off my plate. And the creator-collab part is exactly what burned me before: likes, no customers.
objection: I've seen views and followers go up before with nothing at the till. A Sunday report of views and 'enquiries' doesn't prove anyone walked in or ordered, and I don't trust a creator campaign picked by an AI any more than one I picked myself.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another Bengaluru outlet like mine that the DM-to-WhatsApp enquiries turned into actual orders or bookings, with numbers, not just reach.
